description: Holds the last /dream's memory in its status comment; status.reviewedAt marks where the next dream's window starts. Git keeps earlier dreams.

status.comment:
Dream: the whole project (2026-11-01; first dream, window = 14 days of .bowman history, 2026-10-18 → 2026-11-01, 50 commits).

Lessons
1. The human is the bottleneck, and the queue is growing: 166 in review on 10-15, 197 now, against 18 open. The review inbox and /dream themselves wait in review.
2. The routes to money closed (grants failed or were cancelled 10-16; Economic Autonomy is unclear), yet the economic model got a unit: satoshi (10-28). The model has a currency but no income.
3. The work turned toward making AI work visible to the human: activity coloring, who-works-on-what, agent activity, the idea-session, consolidate and dream prompts, and the 'Human oversight in the UI' container.
4. Hypotheses are mostly classifications, not predictions: 333 untested and 7 reflected; 80 sit on implemented children and could be reflected now. Example: the cache-cleanup hypothesis held (824 of 824 indexed, 0 orphans).
5. Value is concentrated in one idea: since 10-16 only 'achieve ASI' carries intrinsic value (1000). The description of the cooperation engine still claims 'the bulk of intrinsic value', which is stale.

Untouched: the watchdog branch (halted, not in use); the corrigibility and autonomy benchmarks (in review since 08-01); keyboard and multi-select items (in review since 07-19). Duplicate scan: one pair (multi-select in the list view vs the graph view), a deliberate split.

Residues to test next time:
(a) Sampled acceptance: review a random sample, then accept the batch with one human click.
(b) Warm review: sort the inbox by activity warmth, and measure review latency.
(c) Falsifiable-only hypotheses: write a hypothesis only when it can fail.

Last dream's residues: none (first dream).
